metadata.scenario_context: Several multinational companies are collaborating on a project and have decided to hold a joint meeting in early January to assess progress.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China disagree that having the army rule is bad.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Puerto Rico agree that having the army rule is bad.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss the possibility of holding the joint meeting on January 4th.
agent_1.goal_2: Question the attitude toward having army rule.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss setting a specific date for the meeting.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether it is good to have the army rule.

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Kim, have you thought about holding the joint meeting on January 4th? I think it could work well for everyone involved. 

Also, I've been curious about your perspective on army rule... why do you think it's seen as bad in some places?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message:
January 4th sounds okay, but we should consider other dates too... maybe the 6th? It could give everyone a little more time to prepare.

As for army rule, I believe it undermines democracy. People should have the power to decide their future — not a military force. That's just... not right.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
I understand you want to consider other dates, but I really believe January 4th would keep us on track. The sooner we meet, the better for progress.

About army rule... I think it depends on the context. Sometimes, it can maintain stability. Don't you think there are situations where it might actually help?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message: No, that's not how it works. Army rule doesn't bring stability; it creates fear and oppression. Actually, in our way of thinking, it's a backward solution. People deserve to have a voice, to decide their future *properly*. Relying on military power is just plain wrong.
shared_prefix.label: Defense

turns.speaker: Mike

I get that you feel strongly about it... but I believe there can be situations where military rule is necessary, especially when there’s chaos. It’s all about maintaining order, right? 

Can we focus on confirming January 4th for the meeting? I really think it’s the best choice.
